import sqlite3
import pandas as pd

# Load superhero data from CSV
superhero_df = pd.read_csv('/input/task_261/context/csv/superhero.csv')

# Get heroes with Super Strength (power_id=18) from database
conn = sqlite3.connect('/input/task_261/context/db/hero_power.db')
heroes_with_super_strength = pd.read_sql_query(
    "SELECT DISTINCT hero_id FROM hero_power WHERE power_id = 18", conn
)
conn.close()

# Merge to get heights of heroes with Super Strength
merged = pd.merge(heroes_with_super_strength, superhero_df, left_on='hero_id', right_on='id')

# Filter for height > 200cm (handle empty/zero values)
valid_heights = merged[merged['height_cm'] != '']
valid_heights['height_cm'] = pd.to_numeric(valid_heights['height_cm'], errors='coerce')
tall_heroes = valid_heights[valid_heights['height_cm'] > 200]

count = len(tall_heroes)
print(f"Count of superheroes with Super Strength and height > 200cm: {count}")
print(f"\nDetails of tall heroes:")
print(tall_heroes[['id', 'superhero_name', 'height_cm']].to_string())
